title: Ablation Study of a Fairness Auditing Agentic System for Bias Mitigation in Early-Onset Colorectal Cancer Detection

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the LLM agents' ability to identify racial and ethnic disparities (e.g., for Black and Hispanic patients) from clinical literature by measuring the semantic similarity of their generated summaries and recommended sensitive attributes to expert-derived ground truth statements using cosine similarity over sentence embeddings.

Evaluating the LLM agents' ability to identify socioeconomic disparities (e.g., lower education levels, poverty, neighborhood factors, limited access to care) by measuring the semantic similarity of their outputs to expert-derived ground truth statements using cosine similarity over sentence embeddings.

Evaluating the LLM agents' ability to identify sex- or gender-based disparities (e.g., worse survival outcomes for men) by comparing their generated disparity summaries and sensitive attribute recommendations to expert-derived ground truth statements using cosine similarity over sentence embeddings.
